name: DeepSeek-V2-Chat-0628

lifecycle.note: Weights are still public and ungated on Hugging Face. In the DeepSeek API, deepseek-chat moved to DeepSeek-V2.5 on 2024-09-05.

replacedBy.note: In the DeepSeek API only: deepseek-chat and deepseek-coder were upgraded to DeepSeek-V2.5. The weights stay available.

released.note: Date of the API release (deepseek-chat upgraded to DeepSeek-V2-0628). The weights appeared on Hugging Face later; the model card states no date.

relations.note: The model card calls it an improved version of DeepSeek-V2-Chat. According to the V2.5 announcement, DeepSeek replaced the base model of DeepSeek-V2-Chat with the Coder-V2 base for this update.

summary.text: DeepSeek-V2-Chat-0628 is a revised DeepSeek-V2 chat model that went live in the DeepSeek API on 2024-06-28 as DeepSeek-V2-0628 and was later published as open weights under the DeepSeek Model License. For this update DeepSeek replaced the base model of DeepSeek-V2-Chat with the Coder-V2 base.

changes.text: Built on the Coder-V2 base model instead of the DeepSeek-V2 base; DeepSeek says the switch was meant to improve code generation and reasoning.
Instruction following in the system prompt improved, which the model card says helps tasks such as immersive translation and retrieval-augmented generation.
DeepSeek reports stronger role-playing, with the model able to act as different characters on request.
DeepSeek reports better reasoning, coding and maths results than DeepSeek-V2-Chat.

openWeights.note: DeepSeek Model License (license link in the model card).

notes: Released first in the API as DeepSeek-V2-0628 (deepseek-chat), later as open weights under the name DeepSeek-V2-Chat-0628. The model card refers to the DeepSeek-V2 page for model details, so parameters and context window are not restated here. Its base model came from DeepSeek-Coder-V2 (code line, not a record in Model History). The API added JSON mode and function calling on 2024-07-25 while deepseek-chat served this model, but the change log does not tie these features to a model, so no feature is recorded.
